about_the_game:
Welcome to bloody summer camp.

  • In this asymmetric multiplayer horror experience; one player takes on the role of the Slasher, a terrifying killer and the remaining players, and Victims; should escape from the campsite.

  • Play as the Slasher— The Slasher is always hunting. track, trap, and eliminate each Victim one by one. No mercy.
    Unleash your inner maniac with brutal environmental kills.

  • Play as a Victim— As a Victim, your goal is survival; explore the map to find and collect key items, solve puzzles and repair escape vehicles such as a gate or even call for the police. Teamwork is optional, betrayal is always a risk.

  • Sandbox Mode — Unlike traditional gameplay, Sandbox Mode offers a more relaxed, open-ended experience. Allows players to freely explore maps, interact without pressure and create their own scenarios and stories. Whether you're roleplaying a campfire gathering or just hanging out with friends, Sandbox Mode provides a space for creativity and fun.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is an asymmetrical horror game with frequent graphical violence. Blood and gore are present, particularly during finishers, and violence is frequent.

detailed_description:
Victim Revealed!

An energetic girl with surprising strength but subpar stealth skills. You can run, but you cannot hide, so you may as well show the killer your favorite moves.

Full backstory's link available on our official X account: @playsummercamp

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
